budget: 2 cases x (3 source/base/noop + 4 targets x 3 methods) = 30 real forwards. Combined13cases195forwards, numerical<=120s/load<=90s/preparation<=60s estimate; no new fit/data/training/audit.
intervention: Unchanged rank1 signed donor difference, source basis and common source cap0.1 for FCC/dynamic atom/raw. No norm matching to source beyond original shared scale.

probability_endpoints.kl: sum KL(P_source||P_candidate) / sum KL(P_source||P_baseline); float64 log-softmax; denominator <=1e-12*positions yields null
probability_endpoints.nll: observed next-token NLL intervention-minus-baseline vector; report signed means, RMS and normalized squared vector error; source squared energy <=1e-12*positions yields null
probability_endpoints.primary: intervention_positions with valid within-document observed next token
probability_endpoints.scope: joint multi-position interventions, not independent position attribution; secondary suffix may condition on preceding packed documents but no later document positions scored
probability_endpoints.secondary: union of same-document positions downstream from an intervention, excludes EOS predictions and final unavailable token

resource_lease_reason: Bounded inference over existing assets, no whole-disk lease
scope_limit: Existing120documents exposed development; source-rejected scope adds previously missing outcomes. Concentration and weak source effects separated. Absolute probability errors retained; frozen denominator rules yield null when weak. Not global one-to-one or new independent confirmation.
selection: All supported matched source-rejected requests from the fixed matching file, including unchanged donors; preserve selected=false. No new query, donor, fit or target-outcome selection.
